title: Give notice of move from administration to dissolution (AM23)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House of the move from administration to dissolution.

 Use the continuation page to tell us of other insolvency practitioners, if more than 2 are acting.
changeNote: Uploaded the most recent version of the form to give notice of a move from administration to dissolution (AM23).
